Good morning, everyone. I've called this meeting to conduct the final review on the foreign reseller matter before we take any further steps. As you know, our internal review identified payments involving a foreign reseller that generated sanctions-screening alerts, and we have not yet communicated anything to OFAC. The reseller relationship is still active, and we're still holding funds connected with those reviewed payments.

Before I can sign off on any regulator submission or any action regarding the reseller, company policy requires each functional lead to formally enter their findings through the formal finding-entry action for their respective area. I need Thomas to enter the sanctions finding, and I'll need the same from compliance, treasury, and commercial operations. Once all formal findings are documented in the disclosure record, I'll be in a position to close this review and sign off.

Let's get started. Thomas, could you begin with the sanctions finding?
